regime: baryon-safe: PS lmax=400, HOS drop the finest wavelet scale (scales234)
footprint: FULL SKY (healpy), noisy sigma_e=0.26 — NOT the masked paper analysis
method: Gaussian Fisher: linear Jacobian over the 16965-cosmology grid + Hartlap-corrected sample covariance from 200 fiducial perms
caveats: FISHER, not NPE. The Jacobian is a linear response fit and is the dominant approximation; it can over- OR under-state a probe's sensitivity, so do not read the HOS FoM as a bound on the NPE. See the module docstring.
The HOS gain is jacobian-sensitive: l1's 6-param FoM lead over PS l100 is ~x70 with a global linear Jacobian but ~x17 with the local derivative used here (JAC_MODE='local').
200 fiducial perms may under-estimate the non-Gaussian covariance tails of l1/peaks, which would make the HOS look optimistically tight.
FULL-SKY, not the masked paper footprint.
